name: Scope by Ouroboros Apps
description: Scope by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Freelance scope of work: approved scope, rates, deadlines, and change orders, so an assistant cannot promise work or discounts that were not approved. Tools: list_engagements, create_engagement, get_approved_record, save_scope_item, save_rate, save_deadline, approve_scope, file_change_order, approve_change_order. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/scope. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/scope.
author: Ouroboros Apps
